prompts.prompt: Give a friendly one-sentence greeting to someone starting a new job.
Explain what a checksum is in plain language, using no more than two sentences.
Suggest three easy ways to make a short walk more enjoyable.
Rewrite this message politely: Send me the updated schedule before lunch.
Name two useful questions to ask before joining a weekend hiking group.
Write a Go function that returns true when an integer is even.
In Python, show one expression that returns the first item of a list, or None when the list is empty.
What does the HTTP status code 404 mean? Answer in one sentence.
Write a SQL query that selects the name column from a table named books.
Describe the difference between a variable and a constant in one or two sentences.
Extract the date and room from this note: Planning review, 2026-11-03, room Cedar.
Return the two product names from this sentence: We compared the Maple lamp with the River desk.
How many items are listed: pears, plums, and figs? Return only the number.
From this text, extract the contact method: For questions, send a letter to the support desk.
Identify the city and temperature: In Larkhaven the reading was 18 degrees.
A box has 4 red tiles and 3 blue tiles. How many tiles are there in total? Show the addition.
A bus leaves at 9:10 and arrives 35 minutes later. What time does it arrive?
Which is heavier: 900 grams or 1 kilogram? Explain briefly.
There are 12 cups and 4 people share them equally. How many cups does each person get?
A recipe needs 2 lemons per pitcher. How many lemons are needed for 3 pitchers?
Return a JSON object with keys "animal" and "legs" for a spider.
Return a JSON array containing the weekdays Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday.
Return JSON with the string "ok" under the key "status" and the number 3 under "count".
Give one practical tip for keeping a desk tidy.
What command lists files in the current directory on a typical Unix shell?
Extract the order number: Order number QZ-1842 is ready for pickup.
A garden row has 5 plants. Two more rows have the same number. How many plants are there?
A tool named get_weather accepts a city string and returns a forecast. State when an assistant should call it for the question: What is the forecast in Elmport?
Write a two-line thank-you note to a neighbor who watered your plants.
Represent a book titled "North Wind" with 240 pages as a JSON object.
Write a Go function that groups strings by their first rune. Preserve the input order within each group and explain how empty strings are handled.
A Python function mutates a list argument that has a default value of []. Explain the bug and show a safe replacement.
Write a SQL query to find customers with at least three orders, returning customer_id and order_count, ordered by count descending.
Review this pseudocode for a possible off-by-one error: for i from 0 through length(items), print items[i]. Explain the issue and correction.
Design a small JSON response for a paginated list with items, page, page_size, and total_count. Give an example with two items.
Extract each task, owner, and due date from: Mira will test the parser by April 8. Sol will update the guide by April 10. The release check belongs to Ren and is due April 12. Return a table.
From the incident note, extract service, start time, duration, and user impact: Queue service degraded at 14:05 UTC for 18 minutes; delayed notifications affected some users, but no data was lost.
Read the three offers and identify the cheapest total: Oak is 12 dollars plus 4 shipping; Pine is 15 dollars with free shipping; Ash is 10 dollars plus 6 shipping. Show each total.
Extract all quoted values and their units from: The sample measured 2.4 liters, the container held 900 milliliters, and the label listed 1.2 liters.
Turn this record into JSON with title, year, and format: The 2021 audio release was called Quiet Harbor.
A team completes 18 reviews in 3 hours at a steady rate. At the same rate, how long will 42 reviews take? Show the calculation and state an assumption.
A service succeeds on 96 of 100 requests before a change and 190 of 200 after it. Compare the success rates and explain whether the counts alone show a change.
Three jobs take 4, 7, and 9 minutes on one worker. If the worker starts the 9-minute job first, when does each finish? Give the mean completion time.
A shop discounts a 80 dollar item by 25%, then adds 5 dollars shipping. Calculate the final price and explain the order of operations.
A queue has 10 jobs. Each minute 3 finish and 2 new jobs arrive. How many jobs remain after 4 minutes, assuming the queue never goes below zero?

Summarize the following policy in three bullets, retaining the exception: Teams deploy on Tuesday or Thursday after review. Emergency security fixes may deploy any day with incident-lead approval. Every deployment needs an owner and rollback note. A release that changes stored data also needs a tested restore plan. Teams should announce customer-visible changes before deployment.

Compare the project options using only the facts given. Birch costs 18 units and takes 5 days; Cedar costs 22 units and takes 3 days; Fir costs 16 units and takes 7 days. Identify the cheapest and fastest options and explain the tradeoff.

Read this schedule: Monday planning 30 minutes; Tuesday implementation 2 hours; Wednesday review 45 minutes; Thursday fixes 90 minutes; Friday release 20 minutes. Calculate total scheduled time and identify the longest activity.
Return valid JSON for two events: a design review on 2026-11-04 at 10:00 and a demo on 2026-11-06 at 15:30. Use an events array with title, date, and time fields.
Convert these measurements to JSON, preserving units: width 18 centimeters, height 24 centimeters, depth 7 centimeters. Include a dimensions object.

A search_docs tool accepts query and limit, and returns matching document titles and excerpts. A get_doc tool accepts a document_id and returns full text. Explain a safe two-step tool plan for finding the current data-retention rule, and do not invent tool results.

Tools available: convert_currency(amount, from, to) returns a conversion estimate; book_transfer(from_account, to_account, amount) moves funds. The user asks what 25 credits would be in tokens. Which tool, if any, should be called and why?
Draft a concise status update saying the import is complete, validation found two formatting issues, and the team expects a corrected file tomorrow. Keep the tone calm and factual.
Explain why checking that a filename ends in .csv is not enough to validate uploaded CSV content. List two additional checks.
A test suite takes 12 minutes. Parallelizing 4 independent equal parts has 3 minutes of setup overhead. Estimate the new duration and name one assumption.

From this message, list commitments and uncertainty separately: The team plans to publish a draft on Monday. If review finishes early, they may publish the final version Wednesday; otherwise it moves to next week.

A service accepts 60 requests per minute. Its current queue contains 45 requests and drains at 15 per minute while new requests continue at 10 per minute. Estimate how long until the queue empties if both rates stay constant.
Return JSON with a boolean field passed and an errors array containing the two strings missing title and invalid date.

A lookup_inventory tool reads stock levels. A reserve_item tool temporarily reserves a quantity. The user asks whether 5 blue notebooks are available, without asking to reserve them. Describe the appropriate tool use.

A project has 5 tasks: A takes 2 days; B takes 3 days and depends on A; C takes 4 days and depends on A; D takes 1 day and depends on both B and C; E takes 2 days and can run anytime. Find the shortest completion time assuming unlimited workers.
Design a Go function that merges two sorted integer slices without allocating more than one result slice. State complexity, handle duplicates, and give tests for empty input and equal values.

A worker pool processes jobs and reports results on a channel. Explain how cancellation, channel closure, and worker errors should be coordinated to avoid leaks and sends on a closed channel. Give a compact design outline.
Propose a SQL transaction for transferring funds between two accounts. Include a strategy for concurrent updates, insufficient balance, rollback, and idempotent client retries.
Review a cache that stores values by user ID but omits locale from its key. Explain the correctness and privacy risks, and propose a bounded cache key and invalidation strategy.

Design a migration from a nullable text timestamp to a normalized UTC timestamp while old and new application versions may run during deployment. Explain backfill, dual-read or dual-write behavior, validation, and rollback limits.

A monitoring alert fires when the 5-minute error rate exceeds 2%, but traffic varies from 20 to 20,000 requests per minute. Explain why the same threshold has different evidence at those volumes and propose a robust alert with a minimum request count.
Two tests each pass 95% of the time independently. What is the probability both pass in one run, and why would that calculation be invalid if both depend on the same flaky service?

A service has a 1% failure rate. A retry succeeds with probability 90% when the first attempt fails, but retries add load that may raise the initial failure rate. Explain why multiplying probabilities is insufficient and describe measurements needed to assess retries.

A team reports a 20% latency improvement after changing a service, but the new sample contains mostly daytime requests and the old sample mostly overnight requests. Explain the confounder and propose a paired comparison.

An experiment compares average cost per request. One arm has 2% unknown costs and the other has 14%. Explain how excluding unknown costs can bias the result and recommend a decision rule consistent with a 95% coverage requirement.

Extract the obligations, exceptions, and dates from this fictional policy: Standard maintenance is announced five days ahead and occurs Wednesday. A critical security fix may happen sooner with approval from two maintainers. Backups are retained 21 days, except incident snapshots held until closure. The review date is 2026-12-01. Return structured bullets and do not infer missing dates.

Compare the three fictional incident reports and extract common causes versus unique causes. North: stale cache and expired token. East: stale cache and malformed payload. West: expired token and delayed queue. Keep the distinction exact.

From this long note, extract only claims supported by explicit evidence and mark unverified statements: The test log records 41 successful jobs and 2 timeouts. An engineer suspects the timeouts were caused by network load, but no network metrics were collected. The scheduler was changed the previous day. No comparison run was done.

Convert the following fictional inventory into JSON grouped by location, preserving quantities and status: Bay A has 4 sealed kits and 2 open kits; Bay B has 3 sealed kits; Bay C has 1 damaged kit and 5 sealed kits.

A table has columns event_time, account_ref, amount, currency, and state. Given rows (09:00, AX, 12, EUR, settled), (09:04, BY, 7, USD, pending), and (09:06, AX, 12, EUR, settled), summarize distinct settled transactions without treating the repeated row as new.

Analyze this fictional project plan: A and B start together and take 4 and 6 days. C takes 3 days after A. D takes 2 days after both B and C. E takes 5 days after C. F takes 1 day after D and E. Identify the critical path, total duration, and float for the non-critical branch.

A log policy says request bodies are disabled by default, metadata is retained 30 days, and debug mode may capture bodies only in an isolated test environment with synthetic data. Summarize allowed and prohibited production behavior, then identify whether a real customer payload can be used in debug mode.

A survey has 400 responses: 210 chose A, 130 chose B, and 60 skipped. Of A responses, 40 came from a new campaign group of 50 people; the rest came from existing users. Explain what can be concluded about overall preference and why the campaign group's response pattern should not be generalized without more information.

Summarize this fictional contract clause without changing its conditions: Renewal occurs for one year unless either party gives 60 days' notice. A price change requires 90 days' notice. A security breach allows termination after a 10-day cure period unless immediate action is legally required. State deadlines and exceptions separately.

An API has a 1 MiB body limit, 10-second request timeout, and 100 requests per minute per local key. Streaming responses may last 2 minutes but must stop when the client disconnects. Explain which controls bound request size, rate, and stream lifetime, and identify a gap if upstream streams have no idle timeout.

Tools: read_record(id) returns a record; update_record(id, patch, expected_version) writes only if the version matches; send_notice(address, text) sends externally. The user asks to correct a record's date and notify its owner. Outline the safe call order, conflict handling, and confirmation needed before the external notice.

Tools available: search_files(query) returns file names; read_file(path) returns content; delete_file(path) removes a file permanently. The user asks which files are duplicates. Describe a read-only investigation plan and explain why deletion is not justified by the request.

A transfer tool accepts source, destination, amount, and idempotency_key. A balance tool reads current funds. The user asks to transfer 30 units but omits the destination. Explain which tool calls are safe now and what must be clarified first.

Tools: query_orders(filter, limit) reads orders; refund_order(order_id, amount) issues a refund. The user asks whether order R-8 was refunded. Explain the minimum read-only check and why the refund tool must not be called to answer.

Return valid JSON matching this shape: {"decision": string, "evidence": string array, "uncertainties": string array}. Evidence: three of four checks passed; the fourth was not run. Do not claim the release is fully verified.

Return a JSON object for a paired evaluation with baseline "current-auto", candidate "rules", prompts 90, repeats 3, and verdict "INCONCLUSIVE". Include a confidence_interval object with lower -1.2 and upper 4.8, and do not convert the verdict to pass.

Convert these observations into JSON with separate known and unknown arrays: reported cost 0.03 USD; estimated cost 0.02 USD; one request with no cost estimate. Preserve each source label and do not assign a numeric cost to the unknown request.

A paired bootstrap resamples prompts, keeping all repeated trials for a sampled prompt together. Explain what dependency this preserves and why resampling individual requests could make an interval too narrow.

Design input validation for a CSV upload with a header row, up to 10,000 records, and user-supplied values. Cover byte and row limits, malformed fields, duplicate IDs, error reporting, and avoiding exposure of sensitive cell values in logs.

A fictional release checklist says: tests and lint must pass; two reviewers must approve; a migration needs a rollback plan; a paid evaluation has a 5 dollar cap; the evaluation verdict is non-blocking. Summarize required release checks and explain what the evaluation verdict can and cannot change.
